keyFindings.description: With untaken (lookups.go:115-148) a not-due event takes no recipient read, so any not-due event that needs one is incomplete, and its hold names only its short list (owner topic, route, claimant), not the sessions it already reached (delivered). So an event backed off for any reason - a stale role holder, one failed session send - holds every later event of its issue from every other agent and role key until its next retry (up to retry.MaxDelay, 5 min), each round; at bf30591d only the stalled key waited. Contradicts batch.go:367-368 and dispatch-outbox.md:49 ('nothing else') and plan decision 5.

refusedStatement matches any *pgconn.PgError, including a server refusing the connection at startup (ConnectError unwrapping to 53300, 57P03) and FATAL 57P01 on a live connection, so during a failover each recipient kind runs up to 100 more single-id statements on a refusing server; its comment and AGENTS.md say connection failures are not re-run.

No test covers a due later event behind a not-due incomplete event on an unnamed key (deleting batch.go:454-456 stays green), and TestTheBatchTakesNoRecipientReadForAnEventThatIsNotDue passes with untaken deleted.
